rationale: The candidate reads coherently in all four views as one dominant compact mass with a carved internal court/slot and a slight upper taper, so it clears the multi-view coherence gate. The visible relationship to the parcel is good: the mass sits inside the boundary rather than merely boxing it, and the void figure is legible as the main spatial organizer. The thick blue frontage edge is answered by a ground-level open seam/entry response rather than a sealed wall, which supports the neighborhood-living brief. Programmatically, the form can plausibly support a compact mixed-use/street building: it has a clear primary volume, an active threshold, and a public void. The main weakness is the silhouette: the stepped/tapered roof is present but not especially capacity-bearing or sectionally articulate, so it is only moderately convincing as a deliberate section strategy rather than an incidental top deformation. Overall this is a solid early-stage massing with good public void logic and acceptable typological fit.
